notes: VAT 16% (Decree-Law No. 26 of 2024, art. 2(1)) - Palestine's first VAT law, kept at the Paris Protocol band rate after Israel moved to 18%. Relief provisions read: art. 4 exempts non-profit activities (not goods) and the art. 32 zero-rating list (17 categories) has no gold item, so bullion takes 16%. Duty null (customs union with Israel).

sources.name: Ministry of Finance (pmof.ps) - Decree-Law No. 26 of 2024 on Value Added Tax, art. 2(1)
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: the tax is imposed at 16% on all transactions concluded in the State and on the import of goods
sources.quote: تفرض الضريبة بنسبة 16% على كافة الصفقات التي تعقد في الدولة وعلى استيراد البضائع
